name: Baxtan: On Destructive Magics

angles.text: As a mage, you may value treatises on destructive magic as you study arcane power and its dangers.
As a warlock, you may recognize why scholars seek to understand volatile or forbidden powers.
As an Alliance member, you benefit when Alliance libraries expand the knowledge held for all.

aliases: what is baxtan on destructive magics
faq.answer: You bring Baxtan's treatise on destructive magics to a library scholar, adding a work of magic to the collection.
faq.q: What is the quest 'Baxtan: On Destructive Magics'?

faq.answer: Baxtan wrote On Destructive Magics. The scholar who receives it gathers important tomes and magical treatises for the library.

aliases: what kind of books does baxtan want
faq.answer: The library's scholar seeks works of learning and magic for the collection, including treatises you find across the world.
faq.q: What kinds of books is Baxtan looking for?

faq.answer: The gathered texts enter the library's collection, where scholars preserve them for study of the arcane and its dangers.
faq.q: Where does this magical knowledge end up?

faq.answer: Scholars catalog destructive magic to understand the hazards, workings, and forms of potent arcane energies.
faq.q: Why does the library collect works on destructive magic?

aliases: are there more quests for baxtan
can i turn in more books
faq.answer: Yes. The scholar welcomes more magical works you uncover as part of an ongoing effort to gather lore.
faq.q: Can you bring more magical works to Baxtan?

sections.body: Scholars seek to preserve what is known of arcane lore. When you find a text on destructive magic, its place is in careful academic keeping. There, its power and peril can be understood instead of lost.
sections.title: A Tome of Ruinous Arts

sections.body: The library holds works on history, science, and the arcane. Its scholar welcomes travelers who recover forgotten treatises from dangerous corners of the world. Each volume adds to the library's knowledge.
sections.title: Curating the Library's Lore

summary: At the library, Baxtan: On Destructive Magics joins the works scholars gather to understand dangerous arcane power.
attribution: In-game quest text: Baxtan: On Destructive Magics
